cqt.u:Guiding Palm of the Eye: "With piercing eyes, you saw through the Stillness. Undulating as one, you gloriously covered all in white. But... I can bear you no longer." The Dreamer whispered with fogging breath, ice creeping down his hand.
cqt.u:Guiding Palm of the Heart: "Power of the Red Pyre! Flaming Heart of the Hive! I release your burning message to rest here, forevermore." The Dreamer declared, casting out the lingering dark embers within him.
cqt.u:Guiding Palm of the Mind: "Deep in thought, you would tremble the very air before you. Wreathed in light, you nurtured them all. And yet... Your nature became you." The Dreamer mused with aching heart, as remnants of forking tendrils burst forth.

cqt.u:Atziri's Contempt: "My people? I'm not doing this for them. They belong to me. They want this for me. Their sacrifice is a gift they give out of love and adoration... I deserve it. I am their Queen."

cqt.u:Dunkelhalt | Leather Buckler: "A thief in the night, Draven did creep, families asleep, taken, held on high. Clever, he thought, 'til his children paid. Nay, villain, a man never bleeds alone."
cqt.u:Killjoy | Linen Wraps: "Stitches? Wouldn't that defeat the purpose?" - Jeffry, Torturer's Apprentice
cqt.u:Indigon | Magus Tiara: Where the body's limits begin, the mind's limits end.
cqt.u:Sierran Inheritance | Marabout Garb: Born among the high peaks, many Mutewind live their entire lives in snow and ice.
cqt.u:Atziri's Acuity | Moulded Mitts: "The heart is the herald. It will tell me when it is best to strike." - Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
cqt.u:Rise of the Phoenix | Omen Crest Shiel: My bearer shall be guarded by flame, for I am the phoenix, forever radiant in glory.
cqt.u:Calgyra's Arc | Ornate Buckler: "There is nowhere my vengeance cannot find you."
cqt.u:Nightscale | Pauascale Gloves: Diamora sings not for hunger, but for longing.
cqt.u:Vis Mortis | Plated Raiment: Reap what others have sown Muster them from their graves Parade them for your pleasure Zealots in mortis enslaved
cqt.u:Voll's Protector | Plated Vestments: Although a great leader during the war, Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
cqt.u:Jarngreipr | Ringmail Gauntlets: The whispers of the old gods hum through the iron. They demand a hero.
cqt.u:Horns of Bynden | Rusted Greathelm: The younger brother waded into battle, shrugging off blows.
cqt.u:Wings of Caelyn | Rusted Greathelm: The older brother retained calm in the midst of fury.
cqt.u:The Lethal Draw: Life and death ooze from the same sap.
cqt.u:Soul Mantle | Sacrificial Mantle: The greatest mistakes cause suffering long after they have been made
cqt.u:Zerphi's Serape | Scalper's Jacket: Mortality is a curse. The cure is simple.
cqt.u:Idle Hands | Sectioned Bracers: The devil finds work for idle hands.
cqt.u:Cloak of Flame | Silk Robe: He who sows an ember shall reap an inferno.
cqt.u:Silverthorne | Spiked Buckler: As a boy, in the arena, Daresso learned to feign weakness to open up a lethal blow.
cqt.u:Keeper of the Arc | Spiritbone Crown: The priests of the Kalguur keep faith through numbers and calculation, not unprovable promises.
cqt.u:Doedre's Tenure | Stitched Gloves: While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style, she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
cqt.u:Birth of Fury | Stone Greaves: As the sun rises and the light approaches, so too shall your enemies fear you.
cqt.u:Luminous Pace | Straw Sandals: Blessed are those who tend the Grove.
cqt.u:Yriel's Fostering: Feed a beast and it will not hunt. Protect it and it will not fight. Ferocity must be learned, not taught. It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.
cqt.u:Murkshaft: "Boiling frogs isn't for spells, dear. That's a disgusting rumour. They're actually for brewing poisons." - Selassie of the Black Fen
cqt.u:Glimpse of Chaos | Tribal Mask: Man retains sanity and strives toward civilisation only under the blessed veil of ignorance.
cqt.u:Crown of Thorns | Twig Circlet: Lift it lightly, don it slow. The spikes point out and in, you know.
cqt.u:Greed's Embrace | Vaal Cuirass: Some would question if the risk was worth it. The rest were already dead.
cqt.u:The Surrender | Vaal Tower Shield: Our hearts cry out but are silenced by our flesh and so we give up our flesh.
cqt.u:Heatshiver | Velvet Cap: Give of your heated passions. Give of your cold resolve. You will be repaid.
cqt.u:Beyond Reach: The limit of our knowledge is a barrier that protects us from ourselves.
cqt.u:Ironride | Visored Helm: Let the rider's aim be true.
cqt.u:Apep's Supremacy | Voodoo Focus: Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
cqt.u:Window to Paradise | Runemastered Barr: "Beyond fire, blood, and nightmare, the Saviour will build Utopia."
cqt.u:Darkray Vectors | Runemastered Braced: "Sirrius flew on wings of light, faster than wind, faster than thought. But try as he might to outrun the darkness, it was there, at every turn, waiting for him." - Azmerian legend
cqt.u:Pariah's Embrace | Runemastered Cloake: His isolation caused him to treasure their companionship all the more.
cqt.u:Belly of the Beast | Runemastered Expl: There is no safer place Than the Belly of the Beast
cqt.u:Mask of the Sanguimancer | Runemastere: A terror of ancient times, his identity remains lost... but his power does not.
cqt.u:Grip of Winter | Runemastered Firm Bra: After the eruption, the skies turned grey, ash began to fall, and a chill set in...
cqt.u:Kingsguard | Runemastered Full Plate: The toughest armour is the trust of your people.
cqt.u:Erian's Cobble: Sometimes patching up your equipment gets out of hand.
cqt.u:Arvil's Wheel: The unending carnage of war mercilessly grinds away at body and mind.
cqt.u:The Black Doubt: Suspicion is a sinister shadow slithering in the soul.
cqt.u:Leer Cast: For none of us are as cruel as all of us.
cqt.u:Elevore: Ancient worshippers of the Greatwolf were overtaken by a ravenous hunger for all things mystical.
cqt.u:Edyrn's Tusks | Runemastered Iron Cuir: In death, the legendary boar's tusks were turned to the slaying of Phaaryl's Eternal oppressors.
cqt.u:Crest of Ardura | Runemastered Jinglin: When the Red Sekhema called, the Ardura were the first to answer.
cqt.u:The Sunken Vessel | Runemastered Knigh: "What are you lot looking at? We're under fire! Get to your stations!" - Captain Sventura, the Unlucky
cqt.u:Bushwhack | Runemastered Lizardscale B: Banished for his tragic failure, Erian learned to hunt to survive.
cqt.u:Icetomb | Runemastered Mail Vestments: When Solaris closes her burning eye At the end of time, the world will perish in ice.
cqt.u:Titanrot Cataphract | Runemastered Mar: Not the sound of thunder on the wind, but the rhoaback riders—death charging from the sands.
cqt.u:Valako's Vice | Runemastered Plate Gau: Unlike the other gods, when he was born from the volcano, Valako rode the clouds of ash into the thundering sky.
cqt.u:Foxshade | Runemastered Quilted Vest: To catch an animal, think like an animal.
cqt.u:Jarngreipr | Runemastered Ringmail Gau: The whispers of the old gods hum through the iron. They demand a hero.
cqt.u:Bramblejack | Runemastered Rusted Cuir: It is safer to be feared than to be loved.
cqt.u:Horns of Bynden | Runemastered Rusted: The younger brother waded into battle, shrugging off blows.
cqt.u:Soul Mantle | Runemastered Sacrificial: The greatest mistakes cause suffering long after they have been made
cqt.u:The Rat Cage | Runemastered Scout's Ve: The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around. Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.
cqt.u:Idle Hands | Runemastered Sectioned Br: The devil finds work for idle hands.
cqt.u:Oaksworn | Runemastered Sigil Crest Sh: The druids swore to protect the Grelwood with their very lives.
cqt.u:Ezomyte Peak | Runemastered Soldier Gr: Centuries of servitude, a day of glory, an eternity of death.
cqt.u:Wandering Reliquary | Runemastered Ste: Knowing she could outlast any opponent, Wrashmin fought not to win, but to delay.
cqt.u:Doedre's Tenure | Runemastered Stitche: While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style, she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
cqt.u:Birth of Fury | Runemastered Stone Gre: As the sun rises and the light approaches, so too shall your enemies fear you.
cqt.u:Luminous Pace | Runemastered Straw San: Blessed are those who tend the Grove.
cqt.u:Dustbloom | Runemastered Studded Vest: Wraeclast has suffered many great disasters, but life always springs back anew.
cqt.u:Northpaw | Runemastered Suede Bracers: Fight with the ferocity of the First Ones.
cqt.u:Atsak's Sight | Runemastered Veiled Ma: Remaining unseen, the Dishonoured Assassin struck only in the depths of the harshest sandstorms.
cqt.u:The Prisoner's Manacles | Runemastered: Only once did Maligaro wonder if he'd gone too far. His greatest success took three entire legions to capture.
cqt.u:Gloomform | Runemastered Waxed Jacket: It was in this forsaken land, where mists shroud the world in mystery, that thieves, murderers, and outcasts, sought refuge.
cqt.u:The Devouring Diadem | Runemastered Wi: The spirit hungers for the flesh.
cqt.u:Black Sun Crest | Runemastered Wrapped: The beasts we fear the most are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
cqt.u:Visage of Ayah | Runemastered Beaded C: Tale-women do not fight as dekharas. They command a power all their own.
cqt.u:Kitoko's Current | Runemastered Jewell: Reality is a puzzle. Ingenuity is power.
cqt.u:Dunkelhalt | Runemastered Leather Buck: "A thief in the night, Draven did creep, families asleep, taken, held on high. Clever, he thought, 'til his children paid. Nay, villain, a man never bleeds alone."
cqt.u:Dreadfist | Runemastered Bolstered Mit: What is worse, the sting of the past, the pain of the present, or the fear of the future?
cqt.u:The Smiling Knight | Runemastered Cowl: He never spoke a word. His opponents imagined their own personal mockeries, most cruel.
cqt.u:The Eternal Spark | Runemastered Cryst: A flash of blue, a stormcloud's kiss, her motionless dance the pulse of bliss
cqt.u:Crown of the Pale King | Runemastered: A lightless world a silent reign two sightless eyes feed on your pain.
cqt.u:Gloamgown | Runemastered Elementalist: The tale-women of old knew how to build anticipation.
cqt.u:Deidbell | Runemastered Elite Greathel: May you never hear it toll.
cqt.u:Gamblesprint | Runemastered Embossed B: All your tomorrows lie ahead of you, unknown and snarled to the very last.
cqt.u:Bitterbloom | Runemastered Feathered R: The soul cannot flourish in a doubting mind.
cqt.u:Blueflame Bracers | Runemastered Goldc: The secret was lost with its maker.
cqt.u:Apron of Emiran: "Prepare the rack, boy. And be careful with those hooks!" - the Master Torturer's last words
cqt.u:The Hollow Mask: The roots burrow deeper, unveiling the wood's bounty...
cqt.u:Demon Stitcher | Runemastered Intricat: Xibaqua's treachery was met with divine fury. One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh, until all that remained was a droplet of pure light: The first Vaal.
cqt.u:Corpsewade | Runemastered Iron Greaves: Natural decay can be twisted to dark ends.
cqt.u:Prayers for Rain | Runemastered Keth R: In its final era, the roofs of Keth were rife with anything and everything that could hold water... should the opportunity arise.
cqt.u:Widow's Reign | Runemastered Knight Ar: That day, both the Unblinking Eye and their enemies stood in silence. That day, the sky was clear, but it was raining.
cqt.u:Briarpatch | Runemastered Laced Boots: The druids walk the Grelwood without fear.
cqt.u:Bristleboar | Runemastered Leather Ves: When cornered and desperate, look within for the rage to break loose.
cqt.u:Calgyra's Arc | Runemastered Ornate Bu: "There is nowhere my vengeance cannot find you."
cqt.u:Wulfsbane | Runemastered Painted Tower: The Counts of Ogham share a legacy of cunning and power.
cqt.u:Rondel de Ezo | Runemastered Plated Bu: "Resist for long enough, and your oppressor will lose his will. Then, you've won."
cqt.u:Lycosidae | Runemastered Rampart Tower: A true predator does not chase; It waits.
cqt.u:Wings of Caelyn | Runemastered Rusted: The older brother retained calm in the midst of fury.
cqt.u:The Three Dragons | Runemastered Solid: "The ice seared his naked feet As the lightning stilled his heart, But it was the flames upon his lover's face That roused him to vengeance." - From 'The Three Dragons' by Victario of Sarn
cqt.u:Silverthorne | Runemastered Spiked Buc: As a boy, in the arena, Daresso learned to feign weakness to open up a lethal blow.
cqt.u:Obern's Bastion | Runemastered Stacked: The storm cannot sway those of sure footing.
cqt.u:Waveshaper | Runemastered Tideseer Man: "Move in ways your enemy does not expect. Confuse them with elegance and grace. They'll never see the axe coming." - Rakiata, Chieftain of the Tasalio Tribe
cqt.u:Crown of Thorns | Runemastered Twig Ci: Lift it lightly, don it slow. The spikes point out and in, you know.
cqt.u:Irongrasp | Runemastered Vagabond Armo: A power unknown aids your own.
cqt.u:Ironride | Runemastered Visored Helm: Let the rider's aim be true.
cqt.u:Corona of the Red Sun | Runemastered W: Only the High Priests could enact the sacrifices, but all who witnessed shared in exultation.
cqt.u:Nocturne | Runemastered Wooden Buckler: Light and shadow chase eternal, but neither knows the other exists...
cqt.u:Eyes of the Runefather | Venerable Def: From aeons past, Dannig felt the Runefather's gaze, challenging him. There is no honour in ease. True greatness is torn from the jaws of defeat.
cqt.u:Feathered Fortress | Runemastered Cres: Ride the western wind, and take flight.
cqt.u:Atziri's Disdain | Runemastered Gold C: They screamed her name in adulation as they gave their very lives. She looked on with impatience.
cqt.u:Legionstride | Runemastered Rough Grea: A wall of steel and muscle.
cqt.u:Shankgonne | Runemastered Covered Saba: "Captain Hiff Greybeard accomplished what nary a Brinerot could: he died of old age. Almost had him a dozen times meself, if it weren't for that damn leg of his... crafty shite..."
cqt.u:Dionadair | Runemastered Splintered To: Praetor Draven knew his only chance to subjugate the Ezomytes was to catch them unaware.
cqt.u:Apep's Supremacy | Runemastered Voodoo: Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
cqt.u:The Gnashing Sash: "Ghorr knows only hunger, only ravenous feasting. It will consume all that lives, and more!" - Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page fourteen
cqt.u:Mageblood: Rivers of power coursed through their veins. Now, that power is yours, for good or ill.
cqt.u:Headhunter: "A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat. The head is where the Man is." - Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
cqt.u:Eshtera's Path: During the Winter of the World, her akhara began shepherding jingakh across the harsh Vastiri. Sekhema Eshtera planted the seeds of Maraketh diplomacy.
cqt.u:Kalandra's Touch: Power is a matter of perspective.
cqt.u:Bursting Decay: "All Beidat desires is a foothold, a grip on your flesh, on the world... he will offer you anything to get it..." - Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page thirty
cqt.u:Safrin's Resolve: The Vaal protected those who integrated into their culture. Many neighbours became one. Sekhema Safrin vowed the Maraketh identity would remain resolute.
cqt.u:The Taming: "Moon after moon did Berek make fools Of the great and Untamed Three Until malice for a Brother Slew the hatred of the Other And Berek did hunt Alone and free." - Berek and the Untamed
cqt.u:Zaida's Longevity: The relative peace under the fledgling Empire saw the first Sekhema to choose, in her resplendent age and wisdom, to step down. The role of Zaitema was born.
cqt.u:Dream Fragments: Doryani stumbled into a realm of madness And awoke its Master.
cqt.u:Waistgate | Runemastered Heavy Belt: Clever artifice is not always complex.
cqt.u:Snakepit: They wrap around you until your blood turns as cold as theirs.
cqt.u:Berek's Grip: "Berek hid from Storm's lightning wrath In the embrace of oblivious Frost Repelled by ice, blinded by blizzards Storm raged in vain While Berek slept." - Berek and the Untamed
cqt.u:Berek's Pass: "From Frost's ice-bound pass Berek taunted and jeered Until furious Flame scaled the mountain Berek escaped through the thaw And Frost's tortured moans." - Berek and the Untamed
cqt.u:Berek's Respite: "With Flame licking at his heels Berek berated the clouds Until vengeful Storm spewed forth his rains And Berek held on tight As Fire screamed and steamed And fled." - Berek and the Untamed
cqt.u:Blackflame: Beyond the veil of death, there burns a fire by whose light night is borne.
cqt.u:Original Sin: Innocence rose to godhood not on inspired faith, but on the vilification and hatred of another.
cqt.u:Yoke of Suffering: Let the unrepentant be dragged ever downwards by the weight of their sins.
cqt.u:Ventor's Gamble: In a blaze of glory, An anomaly defying all odds The "unkillable" beast met the divine And Ventor met his latest trophy.
cqt.u:Choir of the Storm: But the fool did not bow. The fool stood and questioned. And the fool was unwritten.
cqt.u:Eventide Petals | Veridical Chain: Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke the night-blooming lotus of Middengard's stygian peaks, which grow only where ash meets the snow and stars.
cqt.u:Eventide Petals | Runemastered Veridic: Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke the night-blooming lotus of Middengard's stygian peaks, which grow only where ash meets the snow and stars.
cqt.u:Astramentis: Mindless rage will shake the world, Cunning lies will bend it. Reckless haste will break the world, And into darkness send it.
cqt.u:The Pandemonius: A single moment sets in motion an eternal fall, beneath which all are buried.
cqt.u:Defiance of Destiny: The respect of Karui warriors is hard to earn, but lasts a lifetime... and beyond.
cqt.u:Death Rush: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends
cqt.u:Andvarius: Danger is the price of wealth.
cqt.u:Doedre's Damning: Where her mouth should have been there was only a whirling, black void.
cqt.u:Ingenuity: Experiments with geomancy taught the Maji more than they ever expected.
cqt.u:Serpent's Egg: When Kabala the Serpent Queen was banished from Keth, the Sekhemas took a single hostage as punishment.
cqt.u:Shavronne's Satchel: Bring mystery to life. Again and again.
cqt.u:Waistgate | Heavy Belt: Clever artifice is not always complex.
cqt.u:Thief's Torment: The ring I stole, My finger they took, A shrouded mind, Cut their curses short, As I drained their spirit And stole their soul. A blessing is often a curse.
cqt.u:Darkness Enthroned: Kulemak sat triumphant, raising the crown. Darkness coiled the world in eternal night. Victory, a mere moment, came crashing down. No conqueror, no conquered, only searing Light.
cqt.u:Immaculate Adherence: To stray is to condemn this world to sin.
cqt.u:Ming's Heart: Ming slew Tranquillity Took Chaos for his wife And on Her immortal finger He placed his Heart
cqt.u:Meginord's Girdle: Kaom's strength was rivaled only by the great Meginord of the north.
cqt.u:The Anvil: Forge your Perseverance on the Anvil of Faith.
cqt.u:Rondel of Fragility: Fanatics are the most dangerous enemy, for they care not for their own survival.
cqt.u:Hinekora's Sight: Remember the past, anticipate the future.
cqt.u:Carnage Heart: Forged from the blood of countless wars, its thirst has only begun.
cqt.u:Xoph's Blood: We are his blood. Through us he carries his burning message.
cqt.u:Idol of Uldurn: Worship of house gods was tolerated in Oriath, so long as it remained private.
cqt.u:Surefooted Sigil: Natural grace is born, not earned.
cqt.u:Seed of Cataclysm: The dawn of a new era is set into motion
cqt.u:Goregirdle: Bleeding just means you're still alive.
cqt.u:Strugglescream: There is no light at the end of this inner strife, but the shadows eventually become home.
cqt.u:Call of the Brotherhood: Forged by three brothers so that they may recognize each other across any distance of time or travel.
cqt.u:Fireflower: Tale-women in training drink of a painful desert fruit. Fire, they learn, springs from agony.
cqt.u:Grip of Kulemak: Drink deeply of the Well. Let the Abyss coil within.
cqt.u:Vigilant View: The warriors of the Unblinking Eye moved together as one, shoulder to shoulder.
cqt.u:Perandus Seal: A pact with Prospero always comes at a price.
cqt.u:Icefang Orbit: Those members of the Brotherhood who employ the venom of Trarthan ice snakes must take great care with the volatile substance.
cqt.u:Prized Pain: Agony brings clarity to those of pure mind.
cqt.u:Venopuncture: There is a way to survive the bite of an ice snake, but few have the resolve to attempt it.
cqt.u:Glowswarm: As their eyes adjusted, they became aware of a strange blue light. Countless glowing worms crawled above, blissfully unaware of their flight from the sirens.
cqt.u:Ryslatha's Coil: All creatures have the potential for greatness or unequivocal failure.
cqt.u:Evergrasping Ring: Power comes to those who seek Death comes to those who reach
cqt.u:Heartbound Loop: When the axe finally fell, Seryl shared his pain, and the last thought that flickered through his fading mind was her broken, shattered scream.
cqt.u:Gifts from Above: God blesses those who bless themselves.
cqt.u:Blistering Bond: "The Brotherhood of Silence does not set out to torture our targets. Excruciating pain is simply a byproduct of certain... necessary methods."
cqt.u:Cracklecreep: Fear the fire that spreads like a plague.
cqt.u:Polcirkeln: I rule the north A legacy earned Time and time again Sing Meginord's song!
cqt.u:Whisper of the Brotherhood: Forged by the last remaining brother to return all that was once given.
cqt.u:The Burrower: It coils deeper and deeper It slithers between thoughts It lies beneath the valley It lies in our minds
cqt.u:Veilpiercer: The tribe revelled wildly, unaware that each fruit they ate further bound their continuity to the fog's. In time, the merest touch could break their reality.
cqt.u:Revered Resin: The sacred sap flows slowly, but surely.
cqt.u:Igniferis: A hearth unyielding, ever warm, A light unbroken, endlessly reborn.
cqt.u:Stone of Lazhwar: You are slow, foolish and ignorant. I am not.
cqt.u:Keelhaul: Below all living things, there exists a flow...
cqt.u:Umbilicus Immortalis: "The power of rebirth rivals that of immortality." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3
cqt.u:The Everlasting Gaze: What they saw was what they believed, and they believed Lunaris had not abandoned them.
cqt.u:Bijouborne: Trifle not with the trinket mage.
cqt.u:Zerphi's Genesis: The most horrifying ideas often begin with a simple innovation.
cqt.u:Soul Tether: Vaal bloodpriests were among the earliest intellectuals on record. It was they who found that a newly freed soul would desperately cling to any other source of life.
cqt.u:Coward's Legacy: Death is your most important duty. Face it, or curse your bloodline for all eternity.
cqt.u:Midnight Braid: Adversity is the soil in which persistence grows.
cqt.u:Beacon of Azis: The homeguard signalled for aid against a surprise attack, but it was not their dekharas that responded. It was Solerai herself.
cqt.u:Fixation of Yix: He knew not why he was changing, only that he wanted to hold his family close...
cqt.u:Byrnabas: The Brinerot sail without fear of storms.
cqt.u:Cat O' Nine Tails: A Templar thinks he's righteous for flogging himself once for every ten lashings he gives.
cqt.u:Olroth's Resolve: Olroth the Gallant, tireless and true, he fights for me, he fights for you!
cqt.u:Lavianga's Spirits: "How do I cope with what I witnessed on Wraeclast? Thank the Ancestors! My cup, it overflows." - Lavianga, former advisor to Kaom
cqt.u:Uhtred's Chalice: Uhtred drank. Verisium burned through his veins. He gazed at death's face. With all his strength, he turned instead to the stars, and witnessed Truth.
cqt.u:Melting Maelstrom: What is life, but a dreamlike spiral of panic?
cqt.u:Opportunity: "Calculations complete, and He is assembled. Our immaculate tactics are set in motion."
cqt.u:Blood of the Warrior: "Tukohama may be asleep, but he still gives us his strength. A small needle, an offering, and a vial... drink deeply, my son, and you will more than survive the coming battle... you will thrive."
cqt.u:Voices: Only a madman would ignore a god's instructions.
cqt.u:Grand Spectrum | Ruby: A wellspring of vitality bubbling from within.
cqt.u:Controlled Metamorphosis: Our world was dying, but we chose to survive. We broke free from the chains within.
cqt.u:Against the Darkness: After the fires, in the depths of the Winter of the World, all life in the Vastiri banded together. Whether serpent, hyena, human, or golem, hated enemies clasped hand to claw, built refuge, and fought side by side against the Abyssals. Thus, the Third Pact was born.
cqt.u:Grand Spectrum | Sapphire: Skin like steel tempered by bright flames.
cqt.u:The Adorned: At their height, the Vaal glittered under the sun. A decade, a century, an aeon of prosperity... now nothing more than a passing wonder.
cqt.u:Heart of the Well: Countless souls scream in agonising harmony, forever sinking under the weight of the newly dead.
cqt.u:Heroic Tragedy: They believed themselves courageous and selfless, but that bravery became the doom at their door.
cqt.u:Undying Hate: They believed themselves driven by necessity, but that desperation made them monstrous.
cqt.u:Flesh Crucible: "Never mind the pain, it's only... making room. Unrelated fact, a person can live a normal life with just one kidney. Or just one lung. You never know what Vaal technology will cost you..."
cqt.u:From Nothing: They clawed their way up from the agonising depths of nonexistence, breathing deep with joy the exquisite light of meaning.
cqt.u:Megalomaniac: If you're going to act like you're better than everyone else, make sure you are.
cqt.u:Rite of Passage: To become a warrior and a hunter, each young Azmeri must prove themselves before the Spirit.
cqt.u:The Fall of the Axe: "When the headsman's blade swings, your last moments stretch to eternity." - Vorm, the Twice-Pardoned
cqt.u:For Utopia: "It may be centuries hence, but I still hold utmost faith. The Saviour will rise, and mankind will be free."
cqt.u:Nascent Hope: "Even in the face of the Winter of the World, life found a way. The Spirit always provides."
cqt.u:The Black Cat: The most beloved member of every Brinerot crew is the one that refuses to do any actual work.
cqt.u:Forsaken Bangle: Among the Templars, a secret few ate the sins of others. They bore this burden to empower their hidden Order.
cqt.u:Beira's Anguish: They found a crying child tied to a frozen pyre. She was clad in ice, but the village was ash.
cqt.u:Breath of the Mountains: "To scrape the sky, to touch the clouds themselves, is to know true freedom." - Mutewind saying
cqt.u:Valako's Roar: The sea swells, the sky thunders; two ships tilt at odds. Flashes of light show only swinging axes... and a grin.
cqt.u:Sanguis Heroum: Wraeclast has known too few true heroes. It remembers those that stood in defiance.
cqt.u:Arakaali's Gift: Devotees of the Goddess of Lust needed never fear her sting.
cqt.u:Ngamahu's Chosen: Kaom was not known for his restraint.
cqt.u:The Last Flame: In the coldest depths of the Winter of the World, overrun by darkness and fighting to the last, life itself clung to existence by the barest remaining thread.
cqt.u:The Desperate Alliance: By fire and ice, perhaps the end of the world. They did not fall on their knees and lament.
cqt.u:The Burden of Leadership: The path forward is unknown, but someone must lead. Let it be the best of us.
cqt.u:The Peacemaker's Draught: Centuries of peace brought immense wealth to Keth, but many worried that it had also left the people soft.
cqt.u:The Changing Seasons: All rejoiced when Solerai and Lundara shattered the grey sky, but with the cold banished, sandier climes began to creep in...
cqt.u:The Grand Project: "I see a pattern in these towers. Whoever the Precursors were, they sought to master this world, to shape it as they saw fit. My people had the same ambition..."
cqt.u:Visions of Paradise: "If they had ever completed the tower network, it could have changed the face of the world..."
cqt.u:Freedom of Faith: When darkness comes, we pray for light. When darkness is all that there is, we pray for death.
cqt.u:Unforeseen Consequences: The Well was naught. The Precursors dug too deep. The Well always had been.
cqt.u:Mastered Domain: For a brief shining time, the Precursors could resculpt the world as they saw fit.
cqt.u:Season of the Hunt: Darkness and light, naught but forest between. As the forest fades, the twilight hunt begins.
cqt.u:Cruel Hegemony: The lash of the whip, the ire of the tithe... the press of the boot.
cqt.u:Wraeclast Besieged: In his broken madness, Xesht spills forth the hordes, reaching out to wreak pain and ruination.
cqt.u:Clear Skies: A simple instruction that will purify an entire region, making it safe and kind for weary travellers.

g.t: Plant a seed of Abyssal Energy on the enemy's heart. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes their heart to explode, dealing Physical damage in an area.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area physical duration

g.t: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.

Perform a Warcry using Glory gained by Igniting enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you Trigger Volcanic Steps while travelling, Melee Strikes and Slams are Ancestrally Boosted, and your Melee Strikes Trigger Volcanic Eruption.
g.q: warcry strength grants_active_skill attack buff area melee slam projectile trigger fire duration nova conditional

g.t: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.
Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack ammunition projectile physical

g.t: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast damaging, non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.
This skill is Triggered each time you summon a Totem, summoning an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.

Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area and Aggravating Bleeding on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.
Enemies in your Presence accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying Corrupted Blood to enemies near them.
g.q: grants_active_skill buff persistent area physical duration
grants_active_skill command area projectile fire duration hazard

g.t: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.

Shapeshift into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your Spells. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Maximum 10 Demonflame. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a Spell, or reactivate this Skill.

Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.
g.q: grants_active_skill spell area projectile trigger lightning cold fire chaining

g.t: Create a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.
g.q: grants_active_skill spell area trigger lightning cold fire duration orb

g.t: Consume all stacks of Jade to grant Guard based off your maximum Life for each Jade consumed. You cannot gain Jade stacks while you have Guard.

Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Fire Attack damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby Ignited Enemies. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.
While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Fire spells on reaching maximum Energy.
g.q: grants_active_skill buff persistent trigger fire meta

g.t: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Lightning Attack damage in an area with high chance to Shock. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your Hits immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. The bells are themselves always Primed for Stun, they can be Culled, and Hits against them are always Critical Hits.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack buff persistent area duration

g.t: Channel to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed Melee Attack once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform Channelled Skills or Conditional Skills. Consuming a Power Charge creates additional images.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack melee sustained channelling meta

g.t: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. Critical Hits with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.

Debuff all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Debuff. When the debuff's duration expires or can kill the target, the target loses life equal to that tracked damage all at once.
Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack area trigger lightning cold fire

g.t: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.

Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.

Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.
Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.
While active, firing a ranged Projectile Attack will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.
g.q: buff grants_active_skill persistent trigger duration meta

g.t: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.

Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area. The thrown flask Consumes Poison on Hit to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

While active, Sprinting turns you into a locust swarm which deals Physical Attack damage, which is not based on your Weapon's damage, in an area around you. You take damage and gain Heavy Stun buildup if this Hits any targets, but damage you take from other sources while sprinting will not apply Heavy Stun or interrupt your sprinting.
g.q: buff grants_active_skill attack persistent area physical

g.t: Sacrifice the Corpse of a Rare Monster to grant you its Modifiers for a duration, or gain a single random Modifier at the cost of your own life force.

Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Cold Attack damage in an area and inflicting Exposure. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes Elemental Damage from Hits for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.
g.q: grants_active_skill spell buff persistent lightning cold fire

g.t: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating Fire Spells when Commanded to do so.
Activate to summon a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it.
Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.
Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.
Channel to temper your main hand Melee Martial Weapon. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil Empowers subsequent Attacks to Combust when Hitting enemies.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack buff area melee trigger fire channelling

g.t: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.
Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.
Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.
Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.
g.q: grants_active_skill buff lightning cold fire duration conditional

g.t: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Repeatable Spell you cast to Repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Skills with a Cooldown.

Call upon Spirits of the Stag, sending them leaping forward. Each Stag releases a damaging shockwave each time it lands, and any Stags that travel the maximum possible distance also leave behind Shocked Ground.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack area trigger lightning duration

g.t: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will cause damaging explosions. Copies created this way have 1 Life.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack buff persistent area trigger duration

g.t: Applies a socketed Mark Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. Consuming socketed Marks will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.
While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.

While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.
g.q: strength intelligence grants_active_skill buff persistent duration

g.t: Shapeshift into a Bear and repeatedly pound the ground, creating Molten Fissures that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.
g.q: strength intelligence grants_active_skill attack shapeshift bear area melee slam sustained duration channelling

g.t: While active, strengthens your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while not losing Rage.

Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
g.q: buff grants_active_skill persistent area physical fire detonator travel

g.t: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
g.q: buff intelligence grants_active_skill spell persistent travel

g.t: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.

Mark a target, making them suffer Heavy Stun build up from Blood Loss. The Mark will Activate, Consuming itself to Trigger Blood Explosion, when they are Heavy Stunned, or when they are killed if they suffered enough Blood Loss. The Mark's duration does not expire while the Marked target is suffering Blood Loss.
g.q: mark dexterity grants_active_skill attack area trigger physical duration payoff

g.t: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing Bleeding.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area physical duration repeatable

g.t: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area physical duration nova repeatable

g.t: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.

g.t: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.
While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.
Fire a bouncing Grenade that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini Grenades that explode when they come to a stop.

g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area lightning cold fire payoff remnant repeatable

g.t: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell buff persistent duration

g.t: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your Crossbow shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use Ammunition.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack area ammunition projectile cold conditional

g.t: Dash to an enemy and run them through, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. If this Attack kills at least one enemy, it grants you a Frenzy Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

g.t: Detonate an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy Attack damage to nearby enemies.
Channel to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a Detonating explosion at the end of its flight.

g.t: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Elemental Ailment Threshold, Maximum Elemental Resistances and Flask charges.

g.t: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on Hit. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.

g.t: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill buff persistent lightning cold fire duration

g.t: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
g.q: dexterity intelligence grants_active_skill buff persistent trigger lightning cold fire invocation meta

g.t: Dash to an enemy and nullify their Resistance. Hitting an enemy with positive Elemental Resistance will reduce their highest Elemental Resistance to 0 for a duration and triggers Infuse Weapon, granting your Spear the maximum possible Surges corresponding to the removed Resistance. If this skill doesn't remove any Resistances, its cooldown is reset. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
g.q: dexterity grants_active_skill attack melee strike lightning cold fire duration

g.t: Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.
g.q: dexterity grants_active_skill attack area melee lightning cold fire nova payoff

g.t: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area lightning cold fire duration curse repeatable

g.t: Instantly reload all your Crossbow Ammunition clips and Empower each clip's Ammunition to deal more damage for a duration.
Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.
g.q: strength intelligence grants_active_skill spell area sustained physical duration repeatable plant

g.t: This skill creates a toad that jumps around briefly, the toad then explodes, dealing Attack damage in an area and inflicting Poison. Damage you deal with this skill is not based on your Weapon.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack area trigger physical chaos

g.t: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.

g.t: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area ammunition projectile fire detonator

g.t: Hurl a single payload Spear that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The Spear will explode at the end of its Detonation Time or if Detonated. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating Ignited Ground.
g.q: dexterity grants_active_skill attack area projectile fire duration detonator repeatable

g.t: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a Parried target Consumes the Debuff to cause an explosion of frost and leave Chilled Ground.

g.t: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.

g.t: While active, gains Energy when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to create visages which attack once with a socketed Shapeshifting Attack, creating multiple visages if it has enough Energy.
g.q: strength intelligence grants_active_skill buff persistent invocation meta

g.t: Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area projectile fire repeatable

g.t: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires.
g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area projectile grenade

g.t: Hurl a fiery hammer that Slams into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a Warcry near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of Molten Fissures in a spiral.
g.q: strength grants_active_skill attack area melee slam fire duration

g.t: Perform a Warcry that grants Guard and Triggers Shield Wave when subsequent Shield Attacks deal damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area ammunition projectile payoff merging

g.t: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
g.q: mark dexterity intelligence grants_active_skill buff cold duration

g.t: Passively gains Seals over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the Seals, Repeating for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it Repeats normally, it will also Repeat an additional time targeting a different Ice Fragment in its area of effect if able, Detonating those Ice Fragments immediately.
g.q: dexterity grants_active_skill attack area projectile cold repeatable

g.t: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area projectile cold payoff repeatable

g.t: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.
g.q: dexterity intelligence grants_active_skill attack area melee cold duration

g.t: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill buff persistent aura lightning

g.t: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.
g.q: dexterity grants_active_skill attack area projectile fire chaos duration repeatable

g.t: Fire a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.

g.t: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing causes you to dash towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. Perfectly Timed dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving Shocked Ground in its wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
g.q: dexterity intelligence grants_active_skill attack area melee lightning duration channelling travel

g.t: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area ammunition projectile cold duration

g.t: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.
g.q: buff intelligence grants_active_skill spell minion persistent remnant

g.t: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.
g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area ammunition projectile sustained cold

g.t: Build Glory by Heavy Stunning enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.
g.q: strength grants_active_skill attack area melee slam duration conditional

g.t: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.

g.t: Chills all enemies in your Presence.

g.t: While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon, but is partially based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic, and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.
g.q: buff strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack persistent area physical herald payoff

g.t: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.

g.t: Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and Trigger Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.
g.q: dexterity grants_active_skill spell attack buff area projectile trigger cold duration

g.t: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area sustained cold duration payoff repeatable storm

g.t: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.
g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area ammunition projectile fire merging

g.t: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.
g.q: strength grants_active_skill buff persistent area physical nova

g.t: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a Lightning burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any Chaining Lightning beams can Chain to it. When Chained to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another Lightning burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.
g.q: dexterity grants_active_skill attack area projectile sustained lightning duration repeatable

g.t: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.
g.q: intelligence grants_active_skill spell area fire duration remnant

g.t: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
g.q: strength intelligence grants_active_skill attack shapeshift wolf area melee strike cold

g.t: While active, increases your Block Chance passively and imbues your Shield with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next Block with your Shield raised will expend the lava to Trigger the Magma Spray skill and grant you an Endurance Charge.
g.q: buff strength grants_active_skill attack persistent area melee trigger fire

g.t: Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
g.q: dexterity grants_active_skill attack area projectile lightning

g.t: While active, emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.
g.q: strength intelligence grants_active_skill buff persistent aura duration

g.t: Leech Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly Hindering them.

Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.

Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants Purple Flames of Chayula for a duration.
g.q: dexterity intelligence grants_active_skill buff chaos duration conditional

g.t: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.
g.q: buff dexterity grants_active_skill persistent trigger duration meta

g.t: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.
g.q: strength grants_active_skill attack area projectile fire

g.t: Raise a cannon Ballista Totem which uses socketed Grenade Skills, with significantly improved Cooldown Recovery Rate.
g.q: totem strength dexterity grants_active_skill grenade duration meta

g.t: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and spit Oil at enemies, creating Oil Ground where the Projectiles land. Consumes Power Charges if possible to instead Channel a sustained barrage of electrified Oil that does not create Oil Ground. Projectiles are fired in sequence, allowing multiple Projectiles to Hit the same target.
g.q: strength intelligence grants_active_skill attack shapeshift wyvern area projectile sustained channelling

g.t: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.
g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area projectile grenade fire duration

g.t: While active, emits an Aura that makes enemies in your Presence easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.

Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack melee physical duration channelling

g.t: Channel to charge up your weapon with Fire. Releasing with Perfect Timing will create a damaging wave of intense Fire.
g.q: strength grants_active_skill attack area melee strike fire channelling

g.t: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.
g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area ammunition projectile cold merging

g.t: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Ignite. Igniting any enemy with the Explosion also applies Ignite to enemies within range.
g.q: grants_active_skill attack area projectile fire duration repeatable

g.t: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.
g.q: grants_active_skill spell buff lightning cold fire duration conditional

g.t: Load your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.
g.q: strength dexterity grants_active_skill attack area ammunition projectile lightning channelling

Strike with your Quarterstaff.

Strike with your Spear.

Strike your foes down with a powerful blow using a melee weapon.
